name: Raven-PPT
description:
A powerful deck-building agent that can turn source documents into a fact-grounded .pptx, reviewing every rendered page before it publishes. Use this agent for slides built from material you already have. IMPORTANT: the task text is the only channel that reaches it, so open the task with a fenced block naming the inputs by absolute path, then write the request below it:
```raven-ppt
{"materials": ["/abs/notes.md", "/abs/figures.xlsx"], "template": "/abs/house.pptx"}
```
`template` is optional and names the file the deck is built in, not evidence to quote. A path named only in prose is still picked up, but a quoted one survives spaces and non-ASCII punctuation, which prose does not.
owns: owns decks and slides built from source documents. Do not build the deck yourself.
